assets.title: Introducing Atlas Notes: A Shared Workspace for Small Project Teams
assets.body: Project managers in small teams know how challenging it can be to keep meeting notes and action items aligned. Atlas Notes is a shared meeting-notes workspace designed for small project teams, offering shared notes, reusable meeting templates, and the ability to assign follow-up tasks—all in one place [1]. By keeping notes and tasks together, teams can stay organized and focused on execution [3]. The Starter plan is priced at CAD 12 per user per month [4], with the product launching October 15, 2026 [5]. Learn more to see how Atlas Notes supports clear, practical collaboration for project teams [3].

assets.title: Streamline Your Team’s Meetings with Atlas Notes
assets.body:
Hi there,

We’re excited to introduce Atlas Notes—a shared meeting-notes workspace built for small project teams. With shared notes, reusable meeting templates, and follow-up task assignment, it helps keep your team aligned [1].

Atlas Notes keeps meeting notes and action items together, in a shared workspace [3]. Launching October 15, 2026, the Starter plan will be available at CAD 12 per user per month [4][5].

Learn more about how Atlas Notes can support your team’s workflow.

assets.title: Atlas Notes Launches October 15, 2026, to Support Small Project Teams
assets.body:
Atlas Notes is a new shared meeting-notes workspace designed specifically for small project teams. Launching October 15, 2026, it supports shared notes, reusable meeting templates, and assigning follow-up tasks—helping teams stay organized and aligned [1][5].

The product’s core positioning is simple: keep meeting notes and follow-up tasks together [3]. This practical approach supports project managers who need clarity and consistency across meetings. The Starter plan will be available at CAD 12 per user per month [4].

Learn more about Atlas Notes and how it can streamline your team’s collaboration.

assets.title: Three Ad Variations for Atlas Notes
assets.body:
1. Keep meeting notes and tasks together with Atlas Notes—launching October 15, 2026. Designed for small project teams. Learn more [3][5].

2. Atlas Notes: A shared workspace with reusable templates and task assignment. Starting at CAD 12/user/month [1][4].

3. Small-team project managers: Stay aligned with shared notes and follow-up tasks in Atlas Notes. Launching October 2026. Learn more [1][5].
